data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter marquee widget for smooth multi-direction scrolling content.
data.what_it_does: The Marqueer package provides a versatile Flutter widget to create smooth and customizable marquee effects, news tickers, or scrolling advertisements. It supports infinite or finite scrolling, various directions, speed controls via pixels-per-second, and user interaction handling.
use_when: You need to display a scrolling news ticker or announcement banner.
You require custom multi-directional scrolling (RTL, LTR, TTB, BTT).
You want programmatic control over marquee playback and position using a controller.
avoid_when: You are building standard vertical lists or grids that require complex recycling and layout features.
You need heavy form inputs or complex gesture routing inside every single marquee cell without pointer ignoring configurations.
strengths: Supports multi-directional scrolling and infinite or finite loops.
Includes a controller for programmatic operations like start, stop, and animation.
Provides built-in options for user interaction pause/resume behavior.
weaknesses: Limited to marquee and ticker use cases rather than general-purpose scrolling layouts.
data.minimal_example:
SizedBox(
  height: 30,
  child: Marqueer(
    pps: 100,
    child: const Text('Scrolling marquee text content...'),
  ),
)
